svg.text: Cut the pipe to 2,700 mm, square; file the ends; paint each cut end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with zinc-rich paint so the galvanizing is made good.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the plastic cap into the top end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark with tape, measured up from the bottom end: 600 (ground level),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bands). These are guides only; the parts are set by eye on site.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No holes are drilled in the post: everything clamps to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 600 mm stands in a 300 mm concrete footing, 2,100 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ground, plumb in both directions, 750 mm from the well centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 5 mm over its length; the cap is a push fit.
